7.3.6 Acknowledgement Frame (AF)
This section is Not compliant to ISO 15765-2.
[SWS_FrArTp_00072] ⌈If acknowledgement is configured, every block of CFs is in the
case of a positive acknowledgement acknowledged by an FC frame (as it is in unac-
knowledged connections). Additionally an SF-x, the last block of CFs is acknowledged
by an AF in 1:1 connections, and, in the case of a negative acknowledgement, also
other blocks. This frame type cannot appear in a 1:n connection.
This type of frame looks similar to an FC frame but it has an additional byte.⌋
Acknowledgement Frames consist of FT, FS, BS, STmin, ACK, and SN fields as de-
picted in the Table 7.10
FT (4 Bit)
FS (4 Bit)
BS (8 Bit)
STmin (8 Bit)
ACK (4 Bit)
SN (4 Bit)
Table 7.10: Acknowledgement Frame Layout
[SWS_FrArTp_00073] ⌈An Acknowledgement frame only consists of Protocol Control
Information. This frame is identified by the value 0x7 of the FT field.⌋
[SWS_FrArTp_00074] ⌈FS field is the same as in an FC frame.⌋
